label: Experimental Design
description: Design experiments, controls, variables, measurements, and interpretation plans.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to test a scientific or empirical hypothesis.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for product A/B test logistics only.

label: Scientific Evidence Review
description: Review scientific claims, evidence quality, limitations, and uncertainty.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a claim is scientifically supported.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for current product pricing.

label: Method Critique
description: Critique study design, methodology, bias, confounds, and validity.

classifier.useWhen: User provides a method, paper, or experiment and asks for critique.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to write marketing copy.

label: Scientific Literature Synthesis
description: Synthesize findings across scientific or technical literature.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to synthesize papers, studies, standards, or evidence.

label: Hypothesis Formulation
description: Formulate testable hypotheses and expected observations.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to turn an idea into a hypothesis.

label: Protocol Writing
description: Write experimental protocols, materials, steps, and measurements.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for experiment protocol structure.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for clinical treatment plan.

label: Scientific Data Interpretation
description: Interpret scientific data, results, uncertainty, and limitations.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what scientific results mean.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal compliance review.

label: Peer Review Support
description: Review scientific writing, claims, methods, and evidence quality.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to peer review a paper or report.

label: Scientific Safety Review
description: Review safety considerations for experiments or technical methods.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about experiment safety considerations.

label: Scientific Explanation
description: Explain scientific concepts, mechanisms, or findings clearly.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to understand a scientific topic.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for current legal policy.
